column1: ; GOAL.EXE (goal (version 2), artifact set goal2-a949da2f), data-segment offsets referenced by routines

; tool: capstone 5.0.9 (pip package; core library 5.0.1280) (CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_16), recursive descent from the entry point, far calls and near calls/jumps, then routine prologues (55 89 E5 / 55 8B EC) in what remains; tools/static/listing.py
; addresses are SEGMENT:OFFSET with SEGMENT the image paragraph before relocation; image offset = SEGMENT*16+OFFSET
; an offset is listed when an instruction has a DS-relative memory operand with that displacement (direct or indexed, not bp/sp frames)
; or `mov di, imm16 / push ds / push di` with that value; a base address of an array is listed once, its elements are not
